_doc: THE RECORD OF THE 2026-09-19 LAYOUT SACRED-HOUSE ORDER, the third act under ODQ §934.22 (after the parish-church and religious-quarter-text records, deliberately not folded into either): the spatial generator's village layout lines said 'church' outright — 'Church and green above the tideline', 'a clearing settlement: church, green, and dwellings' — so a Mesoamerican village read as a parish. The desert line already derived its sacred house from what the settlement holds; every line now does, naming the house the settlement actually has (its church, its temple, a wayside shrine) or none. Same seed, different layout sentence: the golden master and the espionage-dormancy fence re-record under this record and no other.
ownerWords: the dossier is setting-agnostic: faith is culture, never a real-world religion named where the settlement holds no such house (§934.22, the surface-leaks order; the deity doctrine)
cause: THE THIRD BROWSER PASS READ 'Church and green above the tideline, a harbour lane leading down to the water' ON A MESOAMERICAN VILLAGE (Muultepec). src/generators/spatialGenerator.js's villageLayouts spelled 'church' in five of seven terrain lines and in the fallback, while its desert line derived the sacred house from the settlement's own institutions. Lane 36's car ceca6a18a makes every layout line derive the same way — the golden moved and was NOT re-recorded by the lane; the chair re-records here.
